assumptions: For an explicitly represented finite source-target DAG with independent exponential activity durations, strictly positive rational rates and a rational deadline T supplied exactly in binary, the manuscript proposes a randomized polynomial-bit algorithm for U=Pr(longest source-target duration >=T). For rational epsilon>0 and 0<delta<1 it would output a binary rational ell with Pr[|ell-ln U|<=epsilon]>=1-delta when U>0, in time/bit work polynomial in graph size, total input bits, 1/epsilon and log(1/delta). It outputs -infinity for U=0 and ell=0 for T<=0 when a path exists. Missing path means U=0 by convention; for T>0 zero-only paths do not contribute. It computes log U without materializing a potentially enormous probability denominator. This is a proof candidate, not validated software or an established algorithmic advance.
contract.interface:
For an explicitly represented finite source-target DAG with independent exponential activity durations, strictly positive rational rates and a rational deadline T supplied exactly in binary, the manuscript proposes a randomized polynomial-bit algorithm for U=Pr(longest source-target duration >=T). For rational epsilon>0 and 0<delta<1 it would output a binary rational ell with Pr[|ell-ln U|<=epsilon]>=1-delta when U>0, in time/bit work polynomial in graph size, total input bits, 1/epsilon and log(1/delta). It outputs -infinity for U=0 and ell=0 for T<=0 when a path exists. Missing path means U=0 by convention; for T>0 zero-only paths do not contribute. It computes log U without materializing a potentially enormous probability denominator. This is a proof candidate, not validated software or an established algorithmic advance.

Mechanism: order relevant activities by (rate,index), partition paths by their minimum-rate anchor, and use a topological skip/select scan rather than scanning in rate order. At most 2n union components comprise anchored overruns A_i with all other class coordinates <T, and single-activity tails B_j={X_j>=T}. For anchor rate lambda, integrate X_i exactly: Pr(A_i)=exp(-lambda T) product_j C_j * p_i, C_j=lambda_j integral_0^T exp[-(lambda_j-lambda)x]dx. The remaining independent q_j densities on [0,T] are decreasing (uniform at equal rates). With S the sum of class non-anchor coordinates and L the longest class path excluding the anchor, R=S-min(L,T)>=0 and p_i=E_q exp(-lambda R)=Pr[omitted path cost<=E AND S<=T+E], E~Exp(lambda). For m non-anchor coordinates p_i>=rho=1/[4 max(1,m lambda T)^m]; rho has polynomial encoding length, not necessarily inverse-polynomial numerical size. m=0 is handled directly.

The crucial smoothing is Pr_q[D(ae,ab)]>=a^m Pr_q[D(e,b)] for 0<a<=1, where D is the downward event with omitted and total resource budgets. It uses decreasing continuous densities and simultaneous scaling BEFORE atomization. It is not a theorem for arbitrary finite-atomic two-budget laws or the original heterogeneous tail. Comparator discretization has step tau/lambda and polynomially many cells from log(1/(tau rho)). Atomization clamps below ell_grid=tau rho/(m d_max), uses g=1+tau/[10m(m+1)] exactly, and rounds both cumulative resources upward. Each resource is bounded by g^(m+1) times its exact value outside the charged small-coordinate event. Retain the first resource point >=2mT, plus zero and absorbing overflow rejection. Endpoint, anchor phase and zero-connector epsilon-elimination preserve path legality and one read per independent activity; no path enumeration or subset determinization is assumed.

Dyadic coordinate laws need polynomial ABSOLUTE precision depending on log(1/rho); use disjoint integer-interval binary decoders with a common denominator 2^b. An ordinary polynomial-size NFA at a polynomial unary word length counts accepted words ONCE, not nondeterministic accepting runs. The sole stated external algorithmic theorem is Arenas–Croquevielle–Jayaram–Riveros #NFA FPRAS (JACM 2021). Conditional generation may self-reduce prefix counts. Jitter accepted atoms under original truncated densities and comparator cells, then set X_i=(T-L)_+ +Z, Z~Exp(lambda), and draw outside-class coordinates from their original laws. A component-weighted union estimator averages 1/M(X) over true containing components, at most K<=2n; log-scale weights avoid huge denominators. Approximate counts, conditional laws, membership failures, concentration and final logarithms have separate budgets. The K symbol for comparator cells in Section 4 is distinct from the union-component K elsewhere.

Finite-bit guards: a rational sampled vector is not asserted close in total variation to a continuous law. Dyadic/word errors couple at word level; conditional jitter uses finite enclosures coupled to ideal continuous variables. Density/conditioning bounds and a union bound over at most 2^n path edge sets give u=zeta rho/[100 n 2^n D] of polynomial bit length for unambiguous membership outside charged exceptions. Coordinates, longest paths and shifted anchors use enclosing intervals; inverse CDF, exponent/log cutoffs, tails, near-equal rates and confidence amplification are charged. If a comparison remains ambiguous or M=0, use a bounded fallback charged to the failure budget. Optional negligible-component omission requires a guarded K-dependent log-gap cutoff and retained-component membership throughout. These all-input precision and runtime guarantees require independent reconstruction.

Scope/acquisition: edge activities or standard vertex splitting with deterministic zero connectors are allowed. Each independent activity occurs at most once per DAG path. Excluded are cycles, correlated durations, repeated physical activities at multiple positions, positive deterministic offsets, arbitrary implicitly specified path families and general finite-atomic two-budget problems. Graph, exact rates and independence/model validity are supplied promises; empirical rate acquisition/calibration, model uncertainty and real project performance are not established. No practical speed or technological readiness follows from the asymptotic candidate.

Evidence: page 6 reports 15,625 exact anchored-union assignments on one six-edge DAG with tied/unequal rates and 10,000 four-coordinate/select-pattern rounding combinations, all assertions passed. No verifier, raw outputs or full sampler implementation accompanies the PDF; nothing was replayed. Page 1 says a separate mathematical check reported no fatal gap after guards, but no review artifact, reviewer identity or external certification is supplied. Preserve these as author reports, not independent verification. Initiating prompt, conversation relation, model, workers and inference expenditure remain UNKNOWN. No novelty claim is made by the manuscript; priority is unresolved.

Family fit: this belongs in the existing algorithms/combinatorics/complexity/networks/probability navigation with a distinct mechanism card. The manuscript explicitly says it is independent of the earlier saturated-transport candidate. N715-saturated-signed-entailment-odd-cycle-probability treats signed undirected product edge-retention, saturated entailment flows and planar unreliability; this draft treats exponential DAG duration tails through decreasing-density rounding and #NFA. It neither depends on, supersedes nor repairs N715. N171/N172 stopped-path/first-passage records concern different stochastic observations and birth-death regimes; they do not supply this finite-DAG counting theorem. Shared rare-event/network vocabulary is not a proven transfer.
